items.title: Gold: strong official demand, losing to rates and the dollar
items.author: Analyst note (AI interpretation)
body: Central banks bought 321 t in Q3 2026, the most since Q4 2024, and global ETF holdings reached a record 4,275 t in October.
Against that, the 10-year real yield is near 18-year highs, a December Fed hike is fully priced and the dollar is at an 18-month high.
Price broke below $3,900 on 12 Nov to its lowest level since October 2025. The long-term case depends on official buying continuing while the hiking cycle ends.

items.title: Bitcoin: ETF selling overwhelms on-chain value
items.author: Analyst note (AI interpretation)
body: US spot ETFs lost $1.28bn in the week of 2–6 Nov, about 5x the Bitcoin mined that week, and 2026 net flows turned negative.
MVRV is low by its own 3-year history, so valuation is not stretched, and corporate treasuries are still buying.
Price lost its 200-day average on 12 Nov and $70,000 on 13 Nov. Flows, not valuation, decide the next few weeks.
